packet.title: XML parsing speed (implementation)
packet.summary: Speeds up XML parsing by making tags and attributes without references single tokens and childless nodes, with content items not rebalanced and fields and node types looked up by number.

body.p: After (tree-sitter parses XML, the owner's choice), (segmented parsing) and , (the benchmarks; parsing a quarter of XMark-All).

item.p: Mechanism: profile parsing alone (callgrind, 10 MB and 100 MB); fewer tokens and nodes in the grammar and its scanner, a cheaper walk; tree-sitter, the segments and the incremental events kept.
Owns: grammars/xml/, src/xml.c, src/xml_segment.c, src/xml_encoding.c; the validation loop of src/string.c.

Done when: MB/s before and after for parse-only and the tree, and XMark-All, in a D-record; xmlconf, QT4 and XT40 unchanged case by case. Done 2026-10-19 (): tags and attributes without references as single tokens and childless nodes, content items without rebalancing, fields by number, node types by symbol. Parse-only 14.9 to 25.2 MB/s, the tree 13.4 to 21.3 MB/s (6.71 to 3.90 x 10^9 instructions at 10 MB); XMark-All 9.87 to 8.88; QT4 and XT40 unchanged case by case.
